description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl, adding {C}{C}.
When The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
